record.question: The main factor influencing global climate zones is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Latitude. Latitude strongly controls solar energy received and is a primary determinant of climate zones. Reference: https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/climate-zones/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
